facts.text: I have an assignment due on Tues, March 28, 2023 by 11:59 pm.
If I choose a 4-day extension for the assignment, it must be submitted before Sat, April 1, 2023 by 11:59 pm.
The Dropbox closes on Wed, April 5, 2023 at 11:59 pm.
Late penalties apply to any assignment submitted between Apr 2 and Apr 5, at 5% per day.
The assignment requires focusing on protection/avoidance strategies in a neighbourhood in Canada.
The assignment requires observing and recording two different types of protection/avoidance strategies in a neighbourhood.
One of the two strategies must be an example of surveillance.
One of the two strategies must be an example of access control.
The report must include photo evidence of the strategies.
The photos must be taken by me.
The photos must not be taken from online sources.
The photos must not be taken from other students in class.
The report must include written evidence explaining the CPTED strategy, why it is a crime prevention strategy, and an evaluation.
The written evidence is expected to be short and succinct, with a maximum of 2 pages write-up per example.
The assignment can include natural or mechanical examples for each strategy.
The assignment submissions can include more than one assignment if changes are made.
Only the most recent file will be graded.
A second file in PDF is allowed as long as one is in Word/text format.
The submission will be processed through Turnitin.com.
The assignment is worth 50 marks.
Each example of crime prevention is worth 20 marks (40 total).
The photo is worth 5 marks.
Strategy type and crime prevention are worth 10 marks.
Evaluation is worth 5 marks.
Formatting (assignment) is worth 5 marks.
Writing is worth 5 marks.
The entire assignment must be submitted as an electronic copy in one file in the Dropbox (MyLS) in Word/text format.
The paper must be double-spaced.
The paper must use 12-point Times New Roman font.
The paper must use one-inch margins in Word format only.
The assignment must include a title page with a title, my name, student ID number, course code and name, university name and campus, and the instructor’s name.
Each example must start on a new page and use a title of the strategy type.
For the photo section, I must provide a photo and details about where the photo was taken.
The photo details must include the neighbourhood, city, the date the photo was taken, and the time of day.
The photo details must be included in the first sentence of the first paragraph.
The photo section must include a general description of what the reader should focus on in the picture(s).
The photo will be graded on evidence of a crime prevention strategy, clarity of the strategy, and originality (taken by me).
The strategy type and crime prevention section must begin by identifying the strategy (surveillance or access control).
I must explain why the strategy is that type by making explicit connections to the literature (textbook and lecture) on CPTED strategies.
No online sources should be used in the strategy type and crime prevention section.
I must tell the reader how the strategy is preventing crime and be specific and explicit.
The evaluation section is based on my thoughts and requires backing up arguments.
In the evaluation, I must say whether I think the strategy works in the neighbourhood and explain why.
In the evaluation, I must suggest what improvement could help prevent crime even more.
